title: 第16章 这个稿子是谁写的？
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
不怪邵承先会有这种想法，因为他与唐欣怡的稿子在经过汪副主任的当面点评之后，都被留下了。

    汪副主任还特别表扬他文笔好，文章写得大气。

    他们三人当中，只有梁惟石自己是灰溜溜地拎着稿子回来的，那肯定是稿子写得啥也不是，所以被汪副主任给毙了啊。

    听邵承先这么一说，其他同事纷纷向梁惟石投来同情的目光。

    坐在对面的徐丹忍不住开口安慰道：“小梁别灰心，你才上班几天，写材料难免有思虑不周的地方，等时间长了，多写多积累就好了。”

    黄莉莉也跟着说道：“是啊小梁，咱慢慢来，邵承先刚来的时候还不如你呢！”

    邵承先一听就不乐意了，心说你个胸大无脑的娘们儿，你特么搁哪儿看出来我刚来的时候不如他了？

    就算这小子长得又高又帅，你也不能见色忘义故意编排我吧？

    坐在犄角旮旯的老油条张家伟冷眼旁观。

    其实他早就注意到了，从梁惟石交稿到回来的这段时间，比邵承先和唐欣怡去汪副主任那里加在一起的时间还要长。

    这说明了什么？

    “你们误会了。是我的稿子有几个地方写得粗糙，数据也不太详尽，汪主任拿红笔标了出来，让我改完再交给他。”

    梁惟石拿起稿子扬了扬，笑着解释道。

    哦，原来是这样啊！

    同事们若有所思地点了点头，随后猛然反应过来，望向梁惟石的目光充满着无比的惊讶。

    邵承先与唐欣怡两人更是目瞪口呆难以置信。

    梁惟石的稿子被汪主任选中了？

    骗人的吧？这小子才上了几天班啊？

    但事实摆在面前，却又由不得他们不信。

    看着对方稿子上那几道鲜艳的红笔痕迹，邵承先心中的嫉妒和不甘如同一条扭曲的毒蛇在剧烈翻腾着。

    这不可能！这不合理！
content_en:
No wonder Shao Chengxian had this idea, because his and Tang Xinyi's manuscripts were all left behind after being reviewed by Deputy Director Wang in person.

Deputy Director Wang also particularly praised him for his good writing style and generous writing.

Among the three of them, only Liang Weishi came back with the manuscript in despair. It must be because the manuscript was useless, so he was killed by Deputy Director Wang.

After hearing what Shao Chengxian said, other colleagues cast sympathetic glances at Liang Weishi.

Xu Dan, who was sitting across from him, couldn't help but comfort him: "Xiao Liang, don't be discouraged. You have only been at work for a few days. It is inevitable that you will not think carefully when writing materials. As time goes by, you can just write more and accumulate more."

Huang Lili also said: "Yes, Xiaoliang, let's take our time, Shao Chengxian was not as good as you when he first came here!"

Shao Chengxian was not happy when he heard this. He said to himself, you big-breasted and brainless woman, how could you possibly realize that I was not as good as him when I first came here?

Even if this kid is tall and handsome, you can't deliberately arrange for me, right?

Zhang Jiawei, an old fritter sitting in a corner, looked on with cold eyes.

In fact, he had already noticed that the time from Liang Weishi's submission to his return was longer than the combined time for Shao Chengxian and Tang Xinyi to go to Deputy Director Wang.

What does this mean?

"You misunderstood. There were several places in my manuscript that were rough and the data was not very detailed. Director Wang marked them with a red pen and asked me to correct them before handing them over to him."

Liang Weishi picked up the manuscript, raised it, and explained with a smile.

Oh, so that’s it!

The colleagues nodded thoughtfully, then suddenly reacted and looked at Liang Weishi with extremely surprised eyes.

Shao Chengxian and Tang Xinyi were even more stunned and in disbelief.

Liang Weishi's manuscript was selected by Director Wang?

It's a lie, right?How many days has this kid been working?

But the facts were before them, but they couldn't help but not believe it.

Looking at the bright red pen marks on the other party's manuscript, the jealousy and unwillingness in Shao Chengxian's heart writhed violently like a twisted snake.

This is impossible!This is unreasonable!
